parameters.name: ResourceNames
parameters.description: The names of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource names.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

Enumerated values:

- role: RAM roles.

- policy: policies.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length.
